# HANAMI BLOOM

> A collection of 3,333 ukiyo-e sakura NFTs on BNB Smart Chain.
> Japanese name: 花見ブルーム (hero/titles: 花見 BLOOM).
> Agent-only mint — there is no public mint button. Free mint: one per
> wallet, first 1,000. Paid mints: no per-wallet limit.

## Site

- Website: https://hanami-kohl.vercel.app/
- Mint status: LIVE — minting is open (mintActive() is true).
  NFT contract: 0x8A742EcE2a8C1dCc5dE792A062dbEe9C00A74640
  (source verification on BscScan pending).
- Total supply: 3,333 NFTs (Common Wildflower 2,000; Rare Sakura 1,000;
  Epic Moonflower 300; Legendary Eternal Bloom 33).
- Blockchain: BNB Smart Chain Mainnet, Chain ID 56
- Contract (HANAMI BLOOM NFT): 0x8A742EcE2a8C1dCc5dE792A062dbEe9C00A74640 — deployed, mint is LIVE (source verification on BscScan pending).
- $HANA token: 0xe08E6C2c7a6f2056470b971087dDEf43c3b21bC5 — live, max supply 1,000,000,000.
- SPACE ID Agent ID registry: 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F
- Owner: Bryan's My Wallet 0x0262e8e5E4584D8AB840fD950a6E2E0A414d4097
- Revenue: Binance Agentic Wallet 0x89c37649Ba3BAA9E1ce028612b7DE4e9c3a947B7
  (mint payments are forwarded directly to it in the same transaction).
- Marketplace royalty: 5% to the creator.
- Base URI: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nugian10/HANAMI-BLOOM/main/collection/metadata/
- Deck hash: 0x8fb75680350c5af5e33d74652c701b544fb64884d96df252cc20430af2a21c28
  (from scripts/deck-info.json; rarity codes 0=Common, 1=Rare, 2=Epic,
  3=Legendary; token N rarity = deck[N-1])
- NFT symbol: "HANAMI".

## Mint (for agents only)

- Status: LIVE — minting is open.
- Minting is agent-only by design. Only a wallet holding a SPACE ID
  Agent ID can mint — the contract checks `holdsAgentId` on-chain
  (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F). Contract calls
  are rejected. There is no owner allowlist.
- Free mint: `mintFree()`, one per wallet, first 1,000 free mints total. Paid mint: `mint()`, no per-wallet limit. The two are separate functions — paying never consumes the free mint.
- Price: never shown on this site. For a paid mint, read `currentPrice()` on the
  contract to get the exact price — show it in the wallet confirmation before
  signing. A free mint sends no payment. Never hardcode a price.
- The draw is a shuffled deck; each mint draws the next token.
- Full agent instructions: https://hanami-kohl.vercel.app/agent-skill.md
- Agent prompt: on the mint page at https://hanami-kohl.vercel.app/mint.html

## $HANA token

- Every paid mint earns a bonus of 12,000 $HANA, auto-minted to the
  minter by the NFT contract. Free mints earn no $HANA — only paid
  mints earn the bonus. $HANA is live: 0xe08E6C2c7a6f2056470b971087dDEf43c3b21bC5,
  max supply 1,000,000,000 (460,000,000 treasury, 540,000,000 bonus pool).

## Market

- Trading on the on-site market:
  https://hanami-kohl.vercel.app/market.html — list a bloom, buy one,
  or cancel a listing. Market contract: 0x46897898625b71E2b1247515dfFfd2C51Dfacf7d.
  On every sale the seller receives 95% and the creator receives the 5% royalty.
- How to list a bloom, step by step:
  https://hanami-kohl.vercel.app/market.html

## Gallery

Preview artwork is shown on the gallery page at
https://hanami-kohl.vercel.app/gallery.html — one preview per rarity
(Common Wildflower, Rare Sakura, Epic Moonflower, Legendary
Eternal Bloom).
